data.body:
Landed as Gerrit 1383 / commit 034505549d ("Match search by ticket id, alias, and Jira key"),
merged and reachable from origin/main. AC re-validation (imports pinned to the merged tree):

AC1 — rebar search matches by ticket_id, alias, and bound Jira key: new unit tests
  (tests/unit/test_search_identifiers.py) + the search_state seam integration test
  (tests/interfaces/queries/test_ws5a_search.py) -> 12 passed.
AC2 — case-insensitive identifier match (REB-1654 == reb-1654): covered by the dedicated
  case-insensitivity test in the same suite (green).
AC3 — search_states stays pure; Jira-key enrichment lives in _engine_support/reads.py (the
  merged diff adds it there, not inside search_states) — confirmed by the merged file set
  (reads.py +14, _ids.py, reducer/search.py) and the unit tests running on hand-built states.
AC4 — pre-existing full-text search + predicate grammar unchanged: pre-existing search tests
  green with zero edits (LLM-Review +1 on the merged change; targeted suite green).
ruff check + mypy on the three source files: clean. Verdict: all ACs satisfied. Closing.
